messages:
ops-broadcast-bot: Incident alert — Regional streaming fallback oscillation causing 502s and websocket disconnects for some hosted customers. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/reg-fallback-174611 :rotating_light:
sam (oncall): Observed repeated region-to-region fallback churn for model-serving routes in eu-west and us-east. Connections are dropped mid-stream when a fallback occurs.
ivy (routing): Fallback logic triggered by transient health check flaps + TTL expiry in routing cache. We see health checks flipping within 5s windows which drives immediate fallback decisions.
diego (sre): Impact: 502s and stream resets for long-lived streaming completions and websocket sessions. Customer reports match high-latency spikes at the same times.
ilnfra-bot: Automated action: routing-cache-evict triggered 3 times in last 20m for route: /v1/stream/gen.
ivy (routing): Mitigation plan: 1) increase health-check hysteresis to 15s, 2) introduce a 10s cooldown before fallback for streaming routes, 3) rehydrate routing cache from control-plane snapshots. Rolling change to canaries now.
sam (oncall): Canary apply successful in eu-canary-1, stream stability improved (0 resyncs after change). Rolling to eu-west then us-east. ETA full rollout ~40m.
lena (cs): Which customers are impacted and what's the opt-in mitigation? Two midmarket customers showed >5% error rate. We can offer to switch them to strict-region-routing or enable temporary hosted-burst.
product-ops: Log suggested UX note for status page: explain streaming-specific fallback behavior and customer options (strict-region-routing). Also ask potential feature to allow customers to disable automatic cross-region fallback.
diego (sre): Temporary workaround for urgent customers: set route annotation `x-redwood-fallback-delay: 30s` and pin to current region. Ops can apply per-request for affected tenants.
ops-broadcast-bot: Status updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/reg-fallback-174611  Current: mitigations rolling, partial customer impact, monitoring.
sam (oncall): Postmortem owners: routing (ivy) + streaming infra (diego). Postmortem ETA: 72h. Internal debrief scheduled 11:00 UTC. If you see regressions tag #eng-oncall and mention sam (oncall).
ops-broadcast-bot: Final thread note (so far)  rollout complete at 1746111800, residual 502s returned to baseline. If any downstream alerts fire, reopen this thread. :white_check_mark:
